slots.notes: Primary UI typeface for the entire section: H2 heading, summary, tab labels, dataset titles, bar labels and value labels. Variable weights 300-760 used; font-metric-sensitive layout (clamp-based sizing).

mechanic: Dark stats section where a 4-tab switcher re-renders an animated horizontal bar chart, replaying staggered CSS keyframe entrances (rows, range indicators, fill bars, and spark-trace crosshairs) on each tab change.
techDelivery: single-file vanilla HTML/CSS/JS section; CSS keyframe animations toggled via .is-ready/.is-visible/.is-active classes, data-driven chart re-render on tab click
reskinNotes: All visuals are CSS-generated (layered radial/linear gradients, repeating-linear-gradient grid lines, radial-gradient spark dots and gradient crosshair pseudo-elements) with no image/video/SVG assets — reskinning means editing hex/rgba in CSS, not swapping files. Accent gradients (#7191d0 -> #aab8d5 -> #8fb0ef -> #d6e3ff) are baked into multiple background/box-shadow declarations and the global --hero-blue / --hero-blue-soft custom properties; the fill-bar and spark gradients hardcode their stops separately and must be updated in sync. All copy (headline, summaries, tab labels, dataset titles, bar labels, notes, numeric values) is hardcoded inside the JS dataset object, not the markup. Layout depends on font metrics via clamp() type scales and minmax() grid tracks; the 4-bar-per-tab count and 4-tab structure are assumed by the staggered --bar-delay (0/90/180/270ms) and per-point delays.
